# Ancient bark

Type: Wood | Internal ID: ElderBark | Source: Ancient Tree, in, Swamp, biomes | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Ancient bark is a different type of wood used in midgame building and crafting recipes.

## Availability

• Acquired by chopping Ancient Trees in the Swamp.
• Requires Bronze axe to acquire.
• Can be found in Sunken Crypts chests.

### Building

• Bonfire
• Butcher's table
• Longship

## Notes

• Ancient bark cannot be fed into a Charcoal kiln.

Categorias: Wood, Materials
